summary: The free strategy lets each host run tasks as fast as it can within the serial batch, so slow or stuck hosts don't block others.
questions: How do I stop slow hosts from holding up the rest?
What's the difference between free and linear strategies?

answer_card.title: free strategy
answer_card.answer_md: `strategy: free` lets each host proceed to the next task without waiting for others (within the `serial` batch). A slow host doesn't block the rest, unlike `linear`.
